name: Saeki Masanaga
source:
The Genbu of Earth from the realm of Ōka

A tall man giving the gloomy aura and an onmyoji working for Minamoto no Yoritomo. 
Age is unknown.
While he is a hardworking man who complains a lot and excel at dealing with vengeful spirits, he hold a rivalry feeling to the protagonist may taking over his current position as Yoritomo's close retainer

Character Designer: Kurage-han (Special Thanks : Miniwa)

[Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/chara07_saekimasanaga]official website[/url]]
